WHEN: task_kind == classification, consumer ridge-raw-plus-difference-v1, metric accuracy, and the deployment-visible pattern reads clipping_probe_direction=unknown, denoising_probe_direction=unknown, estimated_level_offset=low, estimated_region_end_fraction=high, estimated_region_start_fraction=very_low, imputation_probe_direction=unknown, level_excursion_score=high, level_only_post_shift_support_sufficient=True, level_probe_direction=unknown, level_region_end_fraction=very_low, level_region_fraction=very_low, local_robust_z_peak=high, longest_missing_run_fraction=zero, missing_fraction=zero, outlier_region_end_fraction=very_low, period_evidence_status=OK, period_reliability=high, period_repair_available=False, post_shift_support_sufficient=False.
OBSERVE: before proposing, read the deployment-visible features of the current Workspace and note what the readings are.
TRY-HYPOTHESIS: this card records no candidate and expresses no preference among the available options. It is a ranking suggestion about nothing and is not execution authority: it supplies no candidate to the candidate budget and grants no right to deploy.
EVIDENCE: this card carries no accumulated outcome evidence from any prior domain and reports no direction. n = 0. No evidence is weak evidence; it establishes nothing worth a probe, and no fact.
VERIFY: whatever is proposed here holds only if this Target's own held-in Support reads materially positive and the delayed feedback approves the Draft. Nothing is assumed from anywhere else.
FALLBACK: if Support or delayed refuses, drop the candidate and return to identity rather than retrying the same option.

risk_guards.counting_rule: control card; it authorizes nothing and counts toward nothing
